item.title: Unraveling the Origins of C‐Rate Dependent Capacity Decay in Fe‐Mn‐Based Prussian Blue Cathodes for Sodium Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study uniquely links C-rate capacity decay in Mn-doped Fe-PBA cathodes to coupled kinetic mismatch and mechanical failure, rather than isolated transition metal dissolution. By combining multiple in/ex situ techniques, it identifies four degradation pathways—dissolution, mechanical degradation, Na dendrites, and interfacial side reactions—revealing that high-rate collapse at 10 C is fundamentally driven by intrinsic kinetic and mechanical limitations, guiding durable high-power SIB design.
🏷 Prussian blue cathode · sodium-ion battery · capacity decay · high-rate · degradation mechanism

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals how metal centers (Co, Ni, Cu) in conductive 2D MOFs govern magnesium storage, enabling synergistic dual-ion storage via Mg2+ coordination and anion intercalation. Ni3(HITP)2 excels due to its d8 configuration and stable Ni-N π-d conjugation, retaining 201 mAh g−1 after 1100 cycles. It provides molecular-level guidance for designing high-performance organic cathodes for multivalent-ion batteries.

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a spatially integrated intercalation–conversion hybrid cathode combining LiFePO4 and sulfur in a monolayer architecture, synchronizing Li-ion intercalation with sulfur conversion. LiFePO4 suppresses polysulfide shuttling while sulfur boosts capacity. Optimized electrolyte–cathode synergy enables 3000-cycle stability at 0.016% decay per cycle, offering a scalable design principle for durable, high-capacity Li-metal batteries.

💡 Disodium inosinate, a nucleotide additive, is introduced to regulate Zn electrochemistry. Its differentiated phosphate, ribose, and heterocyclic sites enable distinct interactions with Zn²⁺, water, and Zn surface, guiding solvation and Zn(002) deposition. item.title: Cross‐Phase Impurity–Interphase Regulation for Suppressing Thermally Accelerated Failure in Ni‐Rich Pouch Lithium‐Ion Batteries

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 PDVS enables cross-phase regulation in Ni-rich pouch cells by synchronously scavenging HF/H₂O and forming Si-containing interphases on both electrodes. This dual action suppresses coupled impurity–interphase degradation and cross-talk under thermal stress, delivering 92.81% retention after 304 cycles at 45°C and reduced swelling at 60°C. It offers a manufacturing-compatible electrolyte design principle for thermally durable Ni-rich batteries.

item.title: Breaking the High-Voltage Limit of Na2CO3 Presodiation: An Interfacial Engineering Approach to Ampere-Hour Sodium-Ion Devices
item.description:
مهندسی بین‌سطحی، پتانسیل تجزیه Na2CO3 را ۳۵۰ میلی‌ولت کاهش داده و چگالی انرژی باتری سدیم-یونی آمپرساعت را ۲۲.۴٪ افزایش می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work breaks Na2CO3's high-voltage presodiation limit via in situ interfacial oxygen vacancies and electronic reconstruction, cutting decomposition potential by 350 mV. It enables 496.9 mAh g–1 Na+ release, avoids parasitic reactions, and boosts energy density 117.4% in full cells and 22.4% in 1.5 Ah pouch cells, offering a scalable route to high-energy sodium-ion devices.
🏷 Na2CO3 presodiation · sodium-ion capacitor · interfacial engineering · oxygen vacancies · energy density

item.title: Architecting 3D Space‐Charge Heterointerfacial Networks for Electrode‐Scale Ion Transport
item.description:
شبکه‌های ناهمگون فضایی-بار سه‌بعدی در الکترود، انتقال یون را در باتری‌های سدیم-یونی حالت جامد با نرخ بالا تقویت می‌کنند.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers 3D space-charge heterointerfacial networks by organizing Na₂O/Na₂CO₃ nanoionic units into electrode-wide percolating architectures via MOF-templated vapor conversion. It boosts local conductivity by up to 16 orders of magnitude, enabling stable solid-state presodiation and ultrahigh-rate sodium-ion cells. The key advance: spatial connectivity of phase boundaries, not just local space-charge effects, is a programmable design variable for solid-state ionics.
🏷 space-charge · heterointerface · sodium-ion battery · solid-state presodiation · ion transport
